commentaries.author: Parimelazhagar
commentaries.text:
Those who punish the one who harmed them get only that one day’s pleasure, a false pleasure, gloating that they did what they set out to do. Those who bear it have renown until the world perishes, since renown can end only when the world that holds it ends.

பொன்றும் துணையும் says only “until it perishes”. He supplies the world. It could as well be the person’s own death.
